verses.gurmukhi: ਕਬਿਤ: ਚਾਹਿ ਚਾਹਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੁਖ ਚਾਇ ਕੈ ਚਕੋਰ ਚਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਿਰਨ ਅਚਵਤ ਨ ਅਘਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kabit: chaeh chaeh cha(n)dhr mukh chai kai chakor chakh a(n)mirat kiran achavat na aghaane hai ||

en.bdb: Kabitt: Just as Allectoris graeca (chakor) longs for the moon because of the eyes that keep seeing it and is never satiated drinking the nectar-like rays, so does a devoted Sikh of the Guru is never satiated with the glimpse of the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਉਦੋਤ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sun sun anahadh sabadh sravan mirag ana(n)dh udhot kar saa(n)t na samaane hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a deer engrossed by hearing the melodious tune of the musical instrument called Ghanda Herha, but is never satiated hearing it. So is a devoted Sikh never satiated hearing the melody of the unstruck music of Naam Amrit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਲ ਜਸੁ ਜੰਪਤ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਨਿਸ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜੁਗਤ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: rasik rasaal jas ja(n)pat baasur nis chaatirak jugat jihabaa na tirapataane hai ||

en.bdb: Just as the rain-bird is never tired of crying for the nectar like Swati drop day  and night, similarly the tongue of a devoted and obedient disciple of Guru is never tired of repeatedly uttering the ambrosial Naam of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਅਰੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਪਾਵਤ ਸੁਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸ ਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੪੨੩॥
verses.translit_en: dhekhat sunat ar gaavat paavat sukh prem ras bas man magan hiraane hai ||423||

en.bdb: The indescribable celestial happiness one gets by vision of the True Guru, hearing the melodious unstruck sound and singing the praises of the Lord, he remains in a state of ecstasy under the influence of their wondrous and loving relishment. (423)
